mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) despite a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment claims (UNRATE) above 6.5% triggers a negative feedback loop, reducing investor confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 6.5% threshold, or 5d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in consumer spending (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust demand growth, amplifying corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO do not move in tandem, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, persistent low federal funds rates (below 2%) signal accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 2% in late-cycle, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% indicates strengthening labor market conditions, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decline below 6% over the horizon, or returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.0 signals robust supply-side growth, stimulating corporate investment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross 102.0 threshold, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Synchronized increases in consumer spending (GDPC1) and retail sales (HOUST) indicate strong demand momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST do not move in tandem, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery regime, falling unemployment rates (UNRATE below 5.5%) signal labor market normalization, reducing risk aversion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 5.5% in post-recession, or returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).
